excerpt: Journalism (JNL) JNL 211 Cross-Media News Writing (3 Credits) Public Communications Introductory news writing across media platforms. Learn style, formats, and convention for broadcast and online writing and the rationale for each. Emphasis on news values, judgment, and ethics among journalists.
